title: p-curve-v1 player output
description: A single verdict per task: whether the set of significant findings has evidential value by p-curve (right-skew test), with a confidence and optional supporting statistics.

evidential_value.description: True if the set shows evidential value (the p-curve is right-skewed: full-curve right_skew_p < .05); false if the curve is flat (null/false-positive) or left-skewed (p-hacked).

right_skew_p.description: Optional. The full-curve right-skew p-value (Stouffer's combination of the pp-value z-scores) the player computed, if any. Omit (do not send null) when not computed.

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the evidential_value verdict.

flatness_p.description: Optional. The flatness (inadequate-evidence vs 33% power) p-value, if computed. Omit when not computed.
